messages:
DeployBot: Heads-up: planned maintenance window Tue 2025-05-13 02:00-05:00 UTC. Target: runtime kernel micropatch + model runtime ABI bump. Affects: Dedicated GPU pools (eu-west, apac). We'll do rolling restarts by AZ, canary in eu-west-1 first. Creating statuspage incident + customer comms.
Arjun Patel: thanks. Is there an automatic pin fallback for customers on Dedicated? we should pin to last-stable model variant during the window if any request errors spike.
Maya Chen: Support FYI — we'll need a short customer-facing blurb + statuspage snippet and email template. Can someone draft copy? we should call out potential 1-3 min tail latencies and that queries will automatically fallback.
Claire Li: Draft statuspage snippet below (please review):

---
Scheduled maintenance: kernel micropatch and rolling restarts for Dedicated GPU pools in eu-west and apac. Users may see brief interruptions (up to 3 min) and slightly higher latency for warm requests during restarts. We will pin model variants to the previous stable build if errors exceed thresholds. Expected start: Tue 2025-05-13 02:00 UTC.
---

Claire Li: Also adding a short SMS/urgent line for customers on premium SLA: We will message directly if your org is impacted. :phone:
Samir Gupta: ops notes: canary run in eu-west-1 at 02:00, then eu-west-2, then apac regions in staggered 30m windows. Smoke tests after each AZ restart. I'll run canary and attach smoke logs to the incident.
Arjun Patel: rollback/triggers proposal: rollback to pre-release payload if either: p50 latency increases >150ms over baseline for 5 consecutive minutes OR error rate >5% for 3 consecutive minutes. If canary fails, pin all traffic for Dedicated to last-stable and pause rollout. Agree? @Maya @Claire
Maya Chen: agree on thresholds. Support playbook: if pinned, we notify affected customers via email + statuspage and open a private incident channel. Add this template line to the customer email: "We've temporarily routed your traffic to a verified stable model to ensure availability while we investigate."
Claire Li: customer-facing email draft (short):

Hello <OrgName> team,

We will perform a scheduled maintenance on Tue 2025-05-13 02:00 UTC affecting Dedicated GPU pools in eu-west and APAC. You may see brief interruptions or slightly elevated latency while we apply a kernel micropatch and restart nodes. If we detect an issue during the rollout, we will temporarily route your traffic to a verified stable model variant to preserve availability.

No action is required from you. We will post updates on our status page and directly message customers on premium SLAs.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Ops

Samir Gupta: good. Ops checklist snippet:
```
- Verify canary model logs (0b3f9a)
- Run smoke tests (sanity + perf)
- Monitor p50/p95, error rate, queue depth
- If trigger -> pin variant, pause rollout, notify customers
- If pinned >30m -> escalate to infra-eng oncall
```

DeployBot: Created incident: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20250513-03 (will be set to scheduled). I also created a rollout ticket: https://internal.redwood.ai/rollouts/roll-20250513-02.
Arjun Patel: small ask — include the model git SHA in the incident so CS and SRE can correlate. current canary SHA: 0b3f9a3c. Add that to notes.
Claire Li: added CANARY_SHA=0b3f9a3c to incident body. Also added statuspage scheduled maintenance time and the customer blurb.
Maya Chen: I'll prepare the email/sms blast templates and queue for send at 2025-05-12 02:00 UTC (24h prior). Will tag support leads.
Samir Gupta: one more: verify Dedicated customers with custom routing (private deployments) — they might not be auto-pinned. Ops will reach out to each tenant owner before the window.
Arjun Patel: noted. We'll add a line to the internal rollout ticket to manually pin those tenants if needed.
DeployBot: Plan locked. Posting statuspage update at 01:50 UTC. Starting canary at 02:00 UTC. If any of you see anything odd pre-rollout call me out here. :thumbsup:
StatusBot: Incident INC-20250513-03 created and scheduled for 2025-05-13 01:50 UTC. Subscribers notified: internal-ops, eng-platform, support-owners.
Claire Li: final sign-off from eng-platform: :white_check_mark: Arjun, Samir, Claire. I'll publish the customer blurb to statuspage preview now — link posted in the incident.
Arjun Patel: signed. I'll be on watch during the window.
Maya Chen: support is on-call for customer messages. I'll stand by.
DeployBot: I'll update the thread with live canary results and post the 'all clear' when finished. Good luck team. :rocket:
